spec.name: Furniture Witch Stool
spec.description: A crooked dark-oak stool with staggered, joined legs, sturdy stretchers and a plum cushion bearing a small embroidered crescent. Axis-aligned construction fits inside one block; the cushion top is exactly y=14. Front faces negative Z.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: crooked purple witches stool with small moon motif and dark wood legs. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges. Seat cushion top must be at y=14 so a player can sit on it. Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
